title: pm-dispatch: SKILL.md says one patrol routine per project, the references now say one per seat — pick the seat
body:
domain:skills#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc

Filing gate: ② a should-fix of the contract review on PR #28687 (record 6558991413, ④ "unit of the routine"), outside that PR's surface because it needs a `SKILL.md` line. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:skills`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈入口与角色〉 line 「项目席唤醒 = PR 订阅 + 每项目一个自建自绑巡查 routine」; next PR any `SKILL.md` edit in the lane.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "每项目一个" in:body → only #28642; "patrol routine per seat" in:title → none.
reach: every project that sits more than one seat (`pm-dispatch ui skills`), measured in this account's project on 2026-11-01: spec seat 4, devx seat 2 and skills seat 2 each run their own hourly patrol (:48, :18, :33), each bound to its own seat thread.

## What is inconsistent

- `SKILL.md:72` (on `main`): one self-bound patrol routine **per project**.
- After PR #28687: `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉 says taking a seat creates the routine and records `Patrol:` on that seat's stub; `references/project-forms.md` 〈席位是读出来的〉 says 「坐席即建巡查 routine」 and opens one seat thread per seat. That is one routine **per seat**.
- A project seated on two lanes therefore reads one routine from SKILL.md and two from the references. The board practice is per seat: each seat thread binds its own routine, because a routine fires into one session and each seat is its own session.

## Wanted

- `SKILL.md:72` says the unit is the seat (one self-bound patrol routine per seat thread, the director seat excepted), with no other change. Net line count 0 (the ratchet only goes down).
- Tier: `SKILL.md` is the contract-review tier by path (`dispatch-gates --tier`).
